templates.instant: Hi {{firstName}}, this is {{business}}. Thanks for reaching out! We're calling you right now from this number. Reply STOP to opt out.
templates.instant_after_hours: Hi {{firstName}}, this is {{business}}. Thanks for reaching out! Our office is closed, but our assistant is calling now to get the details, and a person will follow up during business hours. Reply STOP to opt out.
templates.followup_5m: Sorry we missed you, {{firstName}}. When is a good time for a quick call about your project? You can also just reply here.
templates.next_day: Hi {{firstName}}, {{business}} following up on your request. Still need help? Reply with a good time and we'll call you.
templates.reactivation: Hi {{firstName}}, {{business}} here. You asked us about a project a while back. We have openings this month if you'd still like a free estimate. Reply YES for a call. Reply STOP to opt out.
templates.opt_out_confirmation: You're unsubscribed from {{business}} texts. No more messages will be sent.
templates.opt_in_confirmation: You're resubscribed to {{business}} texts. Reply STOP at any time to opt out.
templates.help: {{business}}: reply STOP to opt out, or call us at {{callbackNumber}}. Msg and data rates may apply.
